This risk may occur early in the treatment and may increase with duration of use [ see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) ]. Celecoxib is contraindicated in the setting of coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery [ see Contraindications (4) and Warnings and Precautions (5.1) ]. Gastrointestinal Bleeding, Ulceration, and Perforation NSAIDs cause an increased risk of serious gastrointestinal (GI) adverse events including bleeding, ulceration, and perforation of the stomach or intestines, which c an be fatal. These events can occur at any time during use and without warning symptoms.
